nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (every 15m)
nodes.notes: Synth reminder schedule. Service identity injected from n8n credentials store by ID 'CRM_AUTOMATION_HMAC'. Workflow does NOT store raw secrets.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (daily digest 09:00 ICT)
nodes.notes: Daily morning digest. Reuses the same downstream flow as the 15-min trigger but groups items by (organization, owner, supervisor, slaBucket). idempotencyKey window is per (workflowLabel, day) so the 15-min schedule and the digest do not double-notify the same logical reminder (AC #15).

nodes.name: Build envelope (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: No raw body, PII, or secret in the envelope. Body is the claim; signing happens in HTTP Request node.

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (listDueNextActions)
nodes.notes: HMAC signature injected via HMAC credential helper (NOT raw secret). Timeout 5s, no infinite retry (idempotency-key dedupe handles retry). REDACTED wire response never carries actor or source.

nodes.name: Filter + Group (snooze, slaBucket)
nodes.notes: Drop SNOOZED and DONE/CANCELLED. Group by (organization, owner, supervisor, slaBucket). Snooze does NOT mutate SLA or canonical state (N8N/1.1 boundary rule).

nodes.name: Build sendSyntheticReminder batches
nodes.notes: OVERDUE -> audience=SUPERVISOR (escalation, AC #3). No owner AND no supervisor -> FALLBACK, NOT misrouted (AC #5).

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (sendSyntheticReminder)
nodes.notes: Per-group sendSyntheticReminder call. Idempotency key is per (group, day, workflowRevision). Timeout 5s. Same key + same payload returns cached APPLIED (AC #6). Same key + different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (AC #7).

nodes.name: Build acknowledgement batches
nodes.notes: Acknowledgement is audit-only; does NOT mutate NextAction state (N8N/1.1 boundary).

nodes.name: POST /v1/automation/dispatch (acknowledgeReminder)
nodes.notes: Per-group acknowledgement. Idempotency key is per reminder so retries dedupe at the gateway. Timeout 5s, no infinite retry (AC #8).

parameters.content:
## n8n/1.1 — Follow-up / SLA Reminder (LOCAL/MOCK PoC)

Reuses the N8N/0.3 frozen HTTP boundary: POST /v1/automation/dispatch.

Flow:
  1. Trigger: 15-min tick OR daily 09:00 ICT digest (separate trigger nodes).
  2. Build envelope (listDueNextActions).
  3. Call /v1/automation/dispatch (HMAC via CRM_AUTOMATION_HMAC).
  4. Filter snoozeMode==SNOOZED and status!=OPEN; bucket DUE_SOON / OVERDUE.
  5. Group by (organization, owner, supervisor, slaBucket).
  6. Escalation: OVERDUE + supervisor present -> audience=SUPERVISOR.
     No owner AND no supervisor -> FALLBACK (no notification, no misroute).
  7. Call /v1/automation/dispatch (sendSyntheticReminder) per group.
  8. Build acknowledgement envelopes with same correlationId + n8nExecutionId.
  9. Call /v1/automation/dispatch (acknowledgeReminder).

Boundaries:
  - body organizationId is NEVER authority; registry-resolved org/conn wins.
  - Workflow never touches NextAction state, Handling SLA, canonical state.
  - Snooze affects notification ONLY; SLA/canonical unchanged.
  - All 15 acceptance cases (AC #1..AC #15) are covered by focused tests.
  - Logs are redacted; no secret, signature, raw body, or PII leaks.
  - Synthetic channel only (DASHBOARD_ONLY); no email/SMS/Zalo/Chatwoot.
  - No infinite retry; idempotency-key dedupe handles retry; kill switch fail-closed.

LOCAL ONLY:
  - This JSON is exercised by a Node-based local runner/simulator in apps/n8n-workflows/local-runner.mjs.
  - DO NOT IMPORT into the n8n CRM instance until T0 issues the import command and the
    HRP_AUTOMATION_* env vars + CRM_AUTOMATION_HMAC credential are provisioned by the operator.
  - LOCAL_SIMULATOR_VERIFIED, not N8N_RUNTIME_VERIFIED. The simulator walks the JSON node
    graph and drives the actual integration-api HTTP boundary. JSON_STRUCTURE_VERIFIED.
